settings.text: Equip your commercial building with Swarakshit to maintain workplace safety and easily detect combustible gas leaks.

settings.heading: Bring SWARAKSHIT Into Your Workspace
settings.text: Commercial buildings, hotels, and corporate cafeterias require reliable safety tools. The Swarakshit Gas Leak Tester helps facility managers and maintenance staff run routine checks for combustible gas leaks around commercial kitchens, pantry areas, HVAC gas lines, and basement utilities. Compact, rechargeable, and professional.
settings.author: ~ Swarakshit Commercial Safety

settings.title: Cafeteria & Pantry Checks
settings.description: A portable gas monitor for maintenance staff performing daily leak inspections around office cafeterias, commercial stoves, and food-court gas connections.

settings.title: Basement Utility Monitoring
settings.description: Equip your facility team with a highly sensitive device for checking basement utility rooms and HVAC gas lines. The loud 85dB alarm ensures any leak is detected immediately.

settings.title: Multi-Floor Safety Audits
settings.description: Easily check for leaks across sprawling commercial complexes and multiple floors. The 8-10 hour battery life supports comprehensive safety audits without needing a recharge.
